ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure has 9 regions in total: one large central region, with 8 regions around it. The central region shares an edge with all 8 surrounding regions. Among the surrounding regions, the 3 upper regions share edges in sequence to form a chain of length 3; the 3 lower regions also share edges in sequence to form a chain of length 3; except for sharing an edge with the central region, the left and right side rectangular regions do not share edges with other outer-ring regions. Reasoning: Since the central region is adjacent to the other 8 regions, if the central region is not 1 but at least 2, then it must be adjacent to 8 or 9, and the product would exceed 15. So the central region must be filled with 1. The remaining numbers 2 to 9 are filled into the outer ring. In the outer ring, 8 and 9 cannot be adjacent to any remaining number, because 8×2=16 and 9×2=18 both already exceed 15. Therefore 8 and 9 can only be placed in the left and right side regions, with 2 possible orders. The remaining numbers 2 to 7 must be filled into the upper and lower 3-cell chains. Among the remaining numbers, 6 and 7 can only be adjacent to 2, so 6 and 7 must respectively be placed at the two ends of the same 3-cell chain, with 2 in the middle. This chain can be the upper chain or the lower chain, giving 2 choices; swapping 6 and 7 left-right gives 2 choices. The remaining numbers 3, 4, 5 fill the other 3-cell chain. Since 4×5=20>15, 4 and 5 cannot be adjacent, so 3 must be in the middle, with 4 and 5 at the two ends, giving 2 directions. The total number is 2×2×2×2=16.

From the text, the labels are exactly 1 through 9 and every shared-edge product must be at most 15. Since the central field is adjacent to all other fields, it must be labeled 1; otherwise it would be adjacent to either 8 or 9 and the product would exceed 15. Now consider allowed products among the remaining labels 2 through 9. The labels 8 and 9 cannot be adjacent to any other remaining label, so they must occupy the two side boxes, in 2 orders. Among 2 through 7, labels 6 and 7 can only be adjacent to 2, so they must be the two endpoints of one of the 3-field chains with 2 in the middle. The remaining labels 3, 4, 5 must fill the other 3-field chain, with 3 in the middle because 4·5 > 15. Count: choose which side box gets 8 and 9: 2 ways; choose whether the top or bottom chain is 6-2-7: 2 ways; orient 6 and 7: 2 ways; orient 4 and 5: 2 ways. Total 2·2·2·2 = 16.

Then treat each top or bottom 3-field chain as an ordered triple (a, b, c) that must satisfy ab <= 15 and bc <= 15. Make a small table of possible ordered triples from labels 2 through 9. Since 8 and 9 have no valid neighbor among 2 through 9, no valid 3-chain can contain 8 or 9, so they must be the two side boxes. The two 3-chains must therefore partition labels 2 through 7. The valid orders are 6-2-7 or 7-2-6 for the first subset, and 4-3-5 or 5-3-4 for the second. Assign these two chain types to top/bottom in 2 ways and place 8 and 9 in the two side boxes in 2 ways, giving 2·2·2·2 = 16.

因此上下两条3格链要用数字2到7。对一条3格链，若数字为(a,b,c)，必须满足ab≤15且bc≤15。要把{2,3,4,5,6,7}分成两个可排列成合法链的3元组。6和7在这些数中都只能与2相邻，所以6和7必须与2在同一条链中，并且2必须放中间，即{2,6,7}，合法顺序为6-2-7或7-2-6，共2种。剩下另一条链是{3,4,5}，因为4×5=20>15，所以3必须在中间，合法顺序为4-3-5或5-3-4，共2种。

这两类链可以分配给上方或下方，有2种；左右侧边的8和9有2种；两条链内部顺序分别各有2种。因此总数为2×2×2×2=16。

Reasoning: Since the central region is adjacent to the other 8 regions, if the central region is not 1 but at least 2, then it must be adjacent to 8 or 9, and the product would exceed 15. So the central region must be filled with 1.

The remaining numbers 2 to 7 must be filled into the upper and lower 3-cell chains. Among the remaining numbers, 6 and 7 can only be adjacent to 2, so 6 and 7 must respectively be placed at the two ends of the same 3-cell chain, with 2 in the middle. This chain can be the upper chain or the lower chain, giving 2 choices; swapping 6 and 7 left-right gives 2 choices.

The remaining numbers 3, 4, 5 fill the other 3-cell chain. Since 4×5=20>15, 4 and 5 cannot be adjacent, so 3 must be in the middle, with 4 and 5 at the two ends, giving 2 directions.

The total number is 2×2×2×2=16.
